headline: PHI @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 3.22 at MIL 3.86, with a projected total of 7.07. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (PHI -0.32, MIL -0.35), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.66, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Cristopher Sánchez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jackson Chourio, Christian Yelich, Alec Bohm, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Gabriel Rincones Jr., Garrett Stubbs because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
